title: “The Argument” podcast, ad free: Revisiting the affirmative action debate
contentHtml:
Happy Thanksgiving! Today, we’re revisiting Matt and Jerusalem’s contentious debate over affirmative action. We hope the conversation inspires many thoughts and not too many holiday arguments.

Fans of the podcast in the Washington, D.C., area will want to check out the details of our upcoming live show, which will be held at Miracle Theatre on December 9…
